permission: Separate explicit user instruction is required; no certificate, saved approval text or grant. This preparation-time status is not an authentication mechanism.

grid.selection: all36, no posthoc exclusion; original17 plus picklefix C0 ENTRY .3

reference.saved_E_and_gap: not available for neutral reference; no invented comparison value

formulas.D_diag: sum_tail sum_i abs(J_ii); not deterministic baseline
formulas.M: O+D_diag/4+Z; existing exact mapped nonidentity mass
formulas.M_ZZ: O+D_diag/4; sum absolute ZZ-only mapped coefficients
formulas.identity: excluded from all masses; no scalar/Hamiltonian modification

decision.ratio: only paired conditions; denominator above same numerical allowance, otherwise null
decision.primary_fair: C0 PR .1 versus ENTRY .03, budget64; frozen prior policies, explicitly different strengths
decision.failure: missing/corrupt input, wrong SOURCE/identity, nonfinite/asymmetric/dtype error, saved M/E/gap mismatch or invariant/bound violation => STOP; no alternate candidate/retry

allowed: existing saved mass checks and identity residuals
36-row fixed table, 18 matched comparisons and two frozen primary comparisons
excluded: new total RZ estimate or its ranking
outputs: result.json with raw values and identity/saved-mass residuals
resources: light fixed-grid reductions; vectorized existing maps; no artificial CPU/RAM cap; use shared environment without modifications
approval_after_preparation: One user instruction may authorize this whole fixed scope; do not ask at each checkpoint. Do not resume old runs or manufacture approval.
